direct_rc1_consumer_compatibility.cause: RC1 consumer verifier requires the removed ambiguous receipt field authority_state_id; RC2 emits authority_state_claimed_id and authority_state_computed_id instead.

preserved_apparatus_deviations.detail: Initial RC2 reuse wrapper omitted the exact rfc8785 dependency and failed before the scientific pressure matrix executed.

The first preregistered migration attempt failed before matrix execution because YAML indentation altered the multi-line exact-match source block. The replacement was narrowed to one exact source line; candidate bytes were unchanged.

The frozen 101-case artifact retains the historical diagnostic label contract_e_candidate='research-only candidate RC1'. The workflow executed the byte-pinned RC2 reference from candidate_freeze_head; the stale label was deliberately not rewritten because only the preregistered receipt verifier migration was allowed.

semantic_changes_from_rc1: AuthorizationReceipt exposes both authority_state_claimed_id and authority_state_computed_id as separately named normative fields.
Arbitrary fractional-second currentness/revocation comparison is exact rather than host-microsecond-truncated.
Previously implicit request-local uniqueness, supporting-reference resolution, canonicalization, malformed preservation, duplicate-raw-member, and fail-closed blocker behavior are made explicit.
